question: Crisil projects India's bank credit growth to accelerate to how much percentage in FY26?
solution:
The correct answer is __**12-13%**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Crisil, a leading credit rating agency, has projected India's bank credit growth to accelerate to **12-13% in FY26**, reflecting a stable recovery in the economy.
 
• The forecast is primarily driven by **strong retail loan demand** and **improved corporate credit offtake**.
 
• Bank credit growth in India has been recovering steadily post-pandemic due to rising **private consumption and investments**.
 
• Key sectors expected to contribute to this growth include **infrastructure, MSMEs, and personal loans**.
 
• The **government's focus on capital expenditure** is also anticipated to support this credit growth trajectory.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Bank Credit Growth**

 
 
• It refers to the year-on-year growth in loans and advances extended by banks to various sectors of the economy.
 
• It is an important indicator of economic activity and financial stability in the country.
 
 
 
• **Factors Driving Credit Growth**
 
 
• Improved macroeconomic stability and recovery in industrial and service sectors.
 
• Focus on infrastructure spending and government initiatives for MSMEs.
 
• Digitization and ease in loan disbursal processes facilitated by fintech collaborations.
 
 
 
• **Retail Loan Demand**
 
 
• Retail loans include personal loans, home loans, vehicle loans, and credit card loans.
 
• The segment has been the primary driver of credit growth in India due to rising disposable incomes and urbanization.
 
 
 
• **Corporate Credit Offtake**
 
 
• Corporate credit refers to loans taken by businesses for working capital or expansion purposes.
 
• Increased activity in sectors such as manufacturing, construction, and services has bolstered corporate credit demand.
 
 
 
• **Role of RBI**
 
 
• The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) plays a crucial role in regulating credit growth by adjusting interest rates and liquidity measures.
 
• Stable monetary policies and inflation control directly influence credit demand and supply.
